business_problem: Yabble needed to turn large volumes of survey answers and customer feedback into actionable insights faster, because manual coding and analysis could take days or weeks and users were asking increasingly complex questions about their data.
solution_summary: Yabble layered GPT-3 into its customer-insight platform to automate the hardest part of feedback analysis: converting large, unstructured datasets into themes, subthemes, and usable answers. The platform already collected survey responses and customer feedback forms at scale, but analysts still had to spend days or weeks coding results and assembling insights. With GPT-3, Yabble Query can interpret more nuanced natural-language questions from users and return answers grounded in the relevant dataset, while Yabble Count analyzes thousands of comments, tags sentiment, and organizes the data into themes and subthemes. The workflow starts with survey and feedback data entering Yabble, continues through GPT-3-based classification and question answering, and ends with business users consuming richer insight outputs inside Yabble's existing experience. That architecture lets Yabble spend less time on manual analysis and more time helping customers make business decisions.
